clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf brews a draught for a child in Astranaar. He uses rare Bathran's Hair to treat Relara Whitemoon's mysterious, deathly sickness.

Relara Whitemoon, still young, fell deathly ill in Astranaar, and ordinary remedies failed. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sought help from Orendil Broadleaf, a hermit and master of natural medicine who lives in northern Ashenvale. Orendil used bundles of rare Bathran's Hair gathered from the haunted ruins of Bathran's Haunt to brew a draught for Relara. When the vial arrives, it gives Pelturas hope. Yet the cure only slows the disease, so he must seek the further remedies Orendil suggested.
